meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与设计参考图对比，并检查设计系统一致性、文字是否被裁剪、终端界面是否对齐等问题，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了任何网页界面或终端界面，并声称完成时，Claude 会自动触发检查。也适用于你怀疑界面有视觉问题、需要与设计稿比对、或检查中文/日文/韩文文字显示是否正常时。

say.text: 我刚改好了这个页面，帮我做一次视觉质量检查。
检查一下这个终端界面的对齐和边框有没有问题。
这个组件的中文文字好像被裁剪了，帮我确认一下。
say.note: Claude 会专门检查 CJK 文字是否被裁剪或错位。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them to reference designs, checks design system consistency, text clipping, terminal alignment, and synthesizes a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any web or terminal UI and claim it's done. Also when you suspect visual issues, need to compare against a mockup, or check CJK text rendering.

say_en.text: I just finished this page, run a visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots, compare to reference, and run checks.

say_en.text: Check the alignment and borders of this terminal UI.
say_en.note: Claude will capture terminal output and check width, alignment, and wide chars.

say_en.text: The Chinese text in this component seems clipped, please verify.
say_en.note: Claude will specifically check for CJK text clipping or misalignment.
